I do not loathe anyone and seek only peace and true democracy. I am a university educated person and plan to start a career soon. I am fortunate enough to eat and sleep in comfort every day. I understand the strifes of many across the world from my own travels and research. I am desensitized to every form of atrocity from access to the web. It was hard at first to watch some content but now I am able to cope by staying confident that we together can make positive change as long as we stay focused. I have access to a very powerful network of friends and families that encompass key parts of government and business. Anyone willing to help me continue to fight Censorship is welcome to and you have my full support. The American Constitution has been pushed aside in almost every regard by acts such as the Patriot Act and the TPP. I support movements that aim at making real change and not ones that just collect money from donors to then hand of to a bank to manage for years.

I am currently seeking employment in any industry that is forward thinking and will give me experience to enhance my marketing, sales, finance, accounting, IT and new/media skills. I am currently involved with as many charitable organizations as I can handle until I find permanent employment.
